title: Azaane darwaish
body:
Azaan e darwaish
Hussain, Hussain..(4)
Assalamu alaika ya, saarallahi wab na saareh
Assalamu alaika ya, qateelal abaraar
Aarzoo ye dil e mann, mahrame darde dil e mann
aye ghareeb e zahra, jaan e ali, khoone khuda
Tu nahi hai to mera, koi duniya me nahi
<<MINI>>
tere matam ke siwa, koi bhi armaan nahi
hayya alal azaa, hayya alal buka, Hussain Hussain
fi matamil hussain, mazloom e karbala, Hussain Hussain
Karbala ye tu qibla e dilam, arbaabe mann....
Aaaghaa e mann
Aarzoo ...
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera anjaam hai tu, mera aaghaaz hai tu
hai tujhe meri khabar, mera hamraaz hai tu
mai hu deewana tera, meri aawaaz hai tu
<<MINI>>
tere matam ke siwa, koi bhi armaan nahi
hayya alal azaa, hayya alal buka, Hussain Hussain
fi matamil hussain, mazloom e karbala, Hussain Hussain
Karbala ye tu qibla e dilam, arbaabe mann....
Aaaghaa e mann
Aarzoo ...
<<DIVIDER>>
Mi guyad saani e zahra
Aye ghareeb e zahra
Maa ke boodeem pardah nasheen
Az sare naizaa haale man bibeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab e khasta jigar, thi jo paabande rasan
chinn gayi uski rida, tune paaya na kafan
bayn ye karti rahi, laash par teri bahan
<<MINI>>
tere matam ke siwa, koi bhi armaan nahi
hayya alal azaa, hayya alal buka, Hussain Hussain
fi matamil hussain, mazloom e karbala, Hussain Hussain
Man baraye tu girya mikunam, tu baraye mann
Aaaghaa e mann
Aarzoo ...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai takallum ki dua, malike kaun o makaa'n
jis ke aankho'n se sadaa, khoo'n hai ghaibat mein rawaa'n
aake darwaish wo de, sehne kaaba mein azaa'n
<<MINI>>
{hayya alal azaa, hayya alal buka, Hussain Hussain
fi matamil hussain, mazloom e karbala, Hussain Hussain}..(2)
Man baraye tu girya mikunam, tu baraye mann
Aaaghaa e mann
<<DIVIDER>>
Aarzoo ye dil e mann, mahrame darde dil e mann.... Hussain
aye ghareeb e zahra, jaan e ali, khoone khuda.... Hussain
Aynat-talib bi damil maqtoole be karbala..(3)
